title: TSA Commuting Fairness Act
committees: S-Commerce, Science, and Transportation Committee: Referred To 2025-03-11 || H-Homeland Security Committee: Referred To 2025-01-31 [Transportation and Maritime Security Subcommittee: Referred 2025-01-31]
latest_action: Received in the Senate and Read twice and referred to the Committee on Commerce, Science, and Transportation.
summary: TSA Commuting Fairness Act This bill directs the Transportation Security Administration (TSA) to submit to Congress a study on the feasibility of treating as on-duty hours the time TSA employees working at airport locations spend traveling between regular duty locations, airport parking lots, and bus and transit stops.

journey.note: Passed the House; waiting on the Senate
